english.title: Specified person carry out unregistered relevant activity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person, other than a foreign power, specified by the Secretary of State in regulations, carried out a relevant activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), in the United Kingdom in that capacity when that activity was not registered by you with the Secretary of State
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 68(1) and (9) and 80(1) of the National Security Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Relevant activities for the purposes of this offence may be different to the meaning of 'relevant activities' elsewhere under the Act.
(ii) Sections 68(11) provides a defence to this offence, available to a person who has taken all steps reasonably practicable to determine whether the activities in question are or are not registered, and having taken such steps, reasonably believes that they are registered.
(iii) For the offence applying to persons holding officer / members of staff of a specified person, see H101465. See also H101466 for the offence applying to office-holders, employees and staff members of specified persons who are foreign powers that misrepresented relevant activities.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or fine.
Indictment : maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.​​​​​​​

None
